# Maran

> A self-hosted hosting control panel for Linux servers. Manage websites, PHP versions, SSL certificates, databases, file transfer, backups and the firewall from a browser. The panel is written in C#; a small Rust agent is the only process that holds root.

Maran is for hosting providers, agencies and system administrators who run their own Linux servers and give customers their own cabinets. It runs on your server rather than as a service. The interface is available in English, Russian and Armenian. The source is available under the Business Source License 1.1, free to self-host, converting to Apache 2.0 on 29 August 2030. It is built by Innovayse LLC.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/innovayse/maran/blob/main/README.md): what Maran is, supported systems, installation and project status
- [Documentation site](https://maran.innovayse.com/docs): installation, accounts, websites, SSL, databases and the API
- [Architecture](https://github.com/innovayse/maran/blob/main/README.md#architecture): the three processes and why only one holds root
- [Full documentation in one file](https://maran.innovayse.com/llms-full.txt): the English docs concatenated for language models
